subject.title: [Bug]: When openclaw sends a link with an underscore to Feishu, the full hyperlink cannot be displayed

question: Should maintainers sponsor a fresh target-repo Feishu URL-boundary fix, or refresh one of the open fork candidates for this still-open bug?
rationale: The bug is valid and narrow, but this issue is labeled no-new-fix-pr/needs-maintainer-review and same-repository attempts are closed unmerged while linked fork candidates are outside the target repository.

options.title: Sponsor a fresh target-repo fix
options.body: Create or promote one narrow OpenClaw PR in `extensions/feishu` with URL-boundary tests and live Feishu proof before closing this issue.

options.title: Refresh a fork candidate
options.body: Pick the better open fork PR, resolve conflicts against current main, and require focused tests plus live proof before merge.

options.title: Wait for contributor update
options.body: Keep this issue open without new automation until a contributor provides a mergeable, proven PR.

recommendation.title: Sponsor a fresh target-repo fix
recommendation.body: Create or promote one narrow OpenClaw PR in `extensions/feishu` with URL-boundary tests and live Feishu proof before closing this issue.

likelyOwner.reason: Recent Feishu send-path history makes this the strongest current-code routing candidate for choosing the implementation path.
